findings.title: Fake exposed API credential in public JavaScript
findings.evidence: INTERNAL_API_KEY assignment; value is a nonfunctional fixture
findings.remediation: Remove the secret-shaped value from publicly delivered JavaScript. Real privileged credentials and calls belong on the backend.

findings.title: Cross-account order access
findings.evidence: GET /api/order?id=1002&viewer=alice returns Bob's fictional order in vulnerable mode
findings.remediation: Require server-authenticated identity and enforce ownership before returning an order.

findings.title: Content Security Policy header missing
findings.evidence: Content-Security-Policy absent on root response in vulnerable mode
findings.remediation: Set an appropriately restrictive CSP based on app requirements.
